messages:
morgan: blocking on docs PR #578 — need runtime confirmation: if a streaming chat with function_call errors mid-stream, does the server attempt a server-side fallback to a full non-streamed payload?

leah: @morgan can you paste the tiny snippet you used? reviewers want explicit wording.

morgan: here's the inline snippet i have (short):
```js
const s = await client.chat.stream({model:'redwood-v2', messages, functions:[spec], stream:true});
for await (const part of s) { if (part.function_call) handle(part.function_call) }
```

dev-runtime: current runtime behavior: NO automatic server-side fallback. On transient failures we emit a final error chunk using the streaming error envelope and close the connection. HTTP status 500. Planned feature to add server fallback later.

leah: thanks. docs action: replace the sentence that implies fallback with: "Runtime closes streams with an error frame on transient failures; clients should implement retry/fallback patterns. Server-side automatic fallback is planned but not in prod." add a one-line defensive snippet showing try/catch and a retry non-streaming. Keep snippet short to avoid renderer flake.

morgan: will shorten snippet and push. @docs-bot please run preview when I push.

docs-bot: received push to docs/pr-578 — queued preview job id 120999.

docs-bot: preview job 120999 completed — success. link: https://ci.redwood/preview/120999

morgan: resolving blocker, will request reviewers.
